rationale.conceptual: Uses an established, non-trivial DFT workflow (phonon calculations, electron-phonon coupling, supercell relaxations) with multiple interacting components. No new algorithm is introduced, but careful implementation of DFPT parameters, cell constructions, and post-processing is needed.
rationale.execution: Multi-stage pipeline (relaxation, DFPT phonons, two CCDW supercell relaxations, high-pressure sweeps). Dependencies between steps exist, and the agent must handle Quantum ESPRESSO input/output correctly. No exotic data fetching, but several load-bearing handoffs.

difficulty.reasoning: Standard DFT/DFPT application using Quantum ESPRESSO to study phonon instabilities, structural distortions, and superconductivity. The method is well-established, requiring careful setup of computational parameters but no novel algorithm. The pipeline has multiple stages but is sequential and well-defined.

compute_estimate.reasoning: Plane-wave DFT calculations with a cutoff of 35 Ry, moderate k-point (16x16x8) and q-point grids, and small unit/supercells. Runs on CPUs, typical memory usage a few GB, input data (pseudopotentials) negligible.
